blurb: Guests can visit the winery to taste premium wines, dine at the Sonora Room Restaurant, stay overnight in the Guest House with ten guest rooms and a penthouse suite, and attend special events such as the Harvest Long Table Dinner Series. The winery emphasizes environmental sustainability in its operations and vineyard practices. Corporate retreats and private events can be hosted in the Wyse Hall meeting space.
